Change a tuple by converting it to a list.

Supplied answer
my_tuple = (1, 2, 3)
temp = list(my_tuple)
temp.append(4)
my_tuple = tuple(temp)
print(my_tuple) # (1, 2, 3, 4)
single = (5,) # comma is needed for a 1-item tuple
print(type(single))
Note: (5) is just the number 5. (5,) with a comma is a tuple - a favourite trick question.
